full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver ONE square transparent PNG miniature token for Tales of Maj'Eyal: giant white rat. Request 1024 x 1024 pixels; retain the tool's native resolution and alpha.

Identity brief: One large adult ivory rat, unmistakably a rat rather than a small mouse: long pointed muzzle, rounded ears, four visible clawed feet, long naked tail. Alert forebody held visibly higher than its haunches, head angled down-left and separated front paws. Its upper torso forms a tall broad triangle.
Family separation: Compared with the compact warm-brown low crouch of the existing brown rat, this white rat has a taller raised front silhouette and one broad light-value ivory back. Compared with the planned grey rat, keep this one more upright, lighter, and shorter in horizontal reach.
Composition: One entire animal on one disc. Curl the long tail loosely around the left/back inside the rim, clearly detached from the torso; do not put the face in the upper-right UI margin. Keep nose, paws, ears and tail entirely within the disc and readable at 48px.

Match the designated style reference's steep overhead three-quarter camera, upper-left soft light, matte painted miniature finish and thin charcoal-brown physical disc with a restrained bronze-grey bevel. The disc occupies about 82% of the canvas width. All anatomy and equipment must remain inside it, with a clear margin. Use broad readable value planes and a crisp silhouette at 48/64/96px; dark bodies need a broad pale rim or lighter facing plane, not tiny glowing outlines. Keep identity-defining features out of the upper-right rank area and upper-left interaction-marker area. Native references establish identity; they do not override the style reference's camera or disc. Do not copy another species from a style reference.

Palette/material: Warm ivory and bone-white fur in broad areas, soft pink-grey ears and bare tail, dark eyes and nose, gentle warm-grey contact shadow. No glow or effect.
True transparent alpha outside the disc; no painted checkerboard. Keep the entire disc in frame and transparent corners. This is a static identity illustration. Add no faction ring, health arc, shield, rank, crown, UI marker, number, text, aura, scene or floor outside the disc. No recolor-only substitute for a different species, no montage and no alternate variants in one image. Anatomy must match the identity brief, including intentional missing limbs.

Reference roles:
Image 1: style — Use the approved high three-quarter overhead camera, matte sculpted fur, dark physical disc and muted copper-grey rim; do not copy its body or tail pose.
Image 2: identity — Native species and light coat only; ignore native camera and blue effects.
